programmes.name_local: Φορολογική έκπτωση για επενδύσεις σε καινοτόμες επιχειρήσεις
programmes.name_en: Tax deduction for investment in innovative businesses
programmes.amount_note: Investors in certified innovative Cypriot companies can deduct a percentage of the qualifying investment from taxable income, subject to annual caps.
programmes.deadline_note: Certificates are issued on application (email or Ignite platform); the tax incentives for investors are legislated until 31.12.2026.

eligibility.other_note: The company must hold an innovative-enterprise certification; the benefit accrues to the investor rather than the company.

programmes.name_local: PRE-SEED – Δημιουργία και Αρχική Ανάπτυξη Νεοφυών Επιχειρήσεων με Διεθνή Προσανατολισμό
programmes.name_en: PRE-SEED – Creation and Initial Development of Startups with International Orientation
programmes.funder: Ίδρυμα Έρευνας και Καινοτομίας (Research and Innovation Foundation, RIF)
programmes.amount_note: Call budget EUR 1,000,000; maximum funding EUR 119,999 per project (PRE-SEED/0526).
programmes.deadline_note: Call PRE-SEED/0526 closed on 11 September 2026 at 13:00 (Cyprus time). A new call is expected but not yet announced.
programmes.reopen_note: RIF has run PRE-SEED and SEED calls in successive years under the RESTART / Cyprus Research and Innovation Foundation programmes.
